title: Hospital Opening Charge on a Medical Assistance Reserved Bed Extension
content:
The **hospital opening charge** of **Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations** is the private bed-hold charge on the hospital opening entry: the opening resident-private entry of a Medicaid Hospital Leave Reserved Bed hold that carries more than one resident-private entry — the resident-private entry beginning on the reservation's recorded first privately held day. The business office posts the hospital opening charge once the entry is booked.

It concerns a Medical Assistance resident on a hospital leave whose bed is held under a private extension on a reservation carrying more than one resident-private held-days entry; the entry priced is the opening one.

### What the posting does

The charge is recorded on the reservation's ledger, dated the day it is posted, naming the held-days entry it prices and the number of held days it bills, and the reservation's bed-hold balance rises by the amount. The posted charge and its reference number show on the receipt.

### Invocation

`post_hospital_opening_charge_991dca72` is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `bedhold_reservation_id` | the reference number of the bed-hold reservation the charge belongs to, as shown on the reservation record | text reference |
| `days_entry_id` | the reference number of the booked resident-private held-days entry being charged, as shown on the reservation's ledger | text reference |
| `day_count` | the number of held days the charge bills; it is recorded as the charge's day count | a whole number of at least 1, in days |
| `amount` | the bed-hold charge | US dollars, a positive number with 2 decimal places (cents); stored rounded half up to the cent |

No parameter takes an enumerated value.

### Return

A one-line text receipt: "Posted hospital opening charge <charge reference> on reservation <reservation reference> for held-days entry <entry reference>: <days> days, <amount> USD posted <posting date>; bed-hold balance now <balance> USD." The references echo those given, the days are a whole number, the amount and the balance (the reservation's bed-hold balance including the charge) are in USD with two decimals, and the posting date is in year-month-day form. A receipt in this form means the charge is posted.

Errors: a `day_count` that is not a whole number of at least 1 is refused with an error and nothing is posted; an `amount` that is not greater than zero is refused with an error and nothing is posted.
